messages:
Jordan (Mktg): @eng-runtime we need a reproducible rerun for the launch webinar next Wed. Objective: validate latency & cost claims and produce demo-ready artifacts (3 traces, per-token CSVs, aggregated stats). Can you run a controlled sweep and upload to S3?
Alex (eng-runtime): Which model variants, region, and exact metrics? Deadline?
Jordan (Mktg): redwood-large-v1 (fp16) + redwood-large-v1-4bit. Region us-west-2. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, coldstart vs warmed, tokens/sec, per-token cost. Need artifacts by Tue EOD. Tag everything webinar-6181818181.
Maya (Mktg): Cohorts: short<=64, medium 200-512, long 1024-2048. Total ~200 samples split: short=80, med=80, long=40. Use seed=777 for repeatability.
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll run fp16 then 4bit with identical warmup: 5m burst @10 RPS per replica, then steady. We'll capture at least 5 coldstart samples per cohort and pick the median trace for demo artifacts. We'll produce: per-token CSVs for representative traces, aggregated CSV, manifest (model git sha, docker image, runtime flags), README noting nondeterminism.
Sam (Mktg): Please include token, latency_ms, cost_usd columns and a small example payload for the slide pack. Also pre-run cost estimate so Finance can sign off.
Alex (eng-runtime): Ack. We'll post estimated cost before running and start tonight (nonpeak). deploy-bot: pipeline started for benchmark-run/webinar-6181818181 (jobs: bench-run, trace-export)
Priya (eng-runtime): Timeline: run tonight, finish by Tue 18:00 PT, upload to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/6181818181/ with README and manifest. We'll list trace IDs for the three representative traces in the manifest.
Jordan (Mktg): Perfect. Ping this thread when upload completes so we can grab artifacts. Priority: reproducibility and clean artifacts for the live demo. :thumbsup:
